description: Monthly login reward pack. Premium rewards with chances at Epic, Legendary, and special Mythic heroes.

guarantees.description: First card is guaranteed Epic+ Hero
Last card is guaranteed Legendary (any type)
Middle 5 cards are guaranteed Rare or better

heroRestriction.description: Heroes drop at 150% normal rate. All rarities including Mythic available.

mythicHeroes.description: 0.5% chance for Malakar (Mythic hero) on any card slot

pitySystem.description: Mythic hero guaranteed after 12 monthly packs (1 year of play = guaranteed Malakar)

designNotes.purpose: Monthly celebration reward. Premium 7-card pack with Mythic hero chase.
designNotes.heroRate: Slot 1 = 100% Epic+ hero, Slot 7 = Legendary (10% hero rate), 0.5% Malakar per card
designNotes.balance: 1 Epic+ hero guaranteed/month, Malakar after 1 year consistent play (fair F2P endgame)
designNotes.monthlyValue: ~$10-15 equivalent (7 cards, 1 Epic+ hero, 1 Legendary, 20% shiny chance)
